record_title: Arithmetic-progression law for permutation-power nice numbers
scientific_context: An explicit fixed-modulus asymptotic distribution law for permutation-power nice numbers, obtained from the completed even classification and the shifted-squarefree-prime sieve; the odd safe-prime branch is lower order.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The modulus is fixed; no growing-modulus uniformity or optimized error term is claimed. No new infinitude or asymptotic result for Sophie Germain primes is asserted. The classical shifted-squarefree-prime sieve is prior art. Kowitz (2025) was inspected only through bibliographic and abstract-level material, leaving a residual originality risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.

artifact_inventory.description: Standalone finite enumeration of squarefree-predecessor primes, Artin-product comparison, and the modulo-6 split.
Deterministic output of verify.py at prime limit 10^6.
